verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so user-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions the firm's internal use of AI/ML contract-review legaltech and a legaltech incubator, but neither is a user-facing automation capability, so the axis does not become applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
